text: sasha: quick a11y poke — I pushed a tiny PR for the Models list badges (status/quantized/preview). can someone do a fast SR + keyboard sanity check? link: https://stash/redwood/pr/4821 :eyes: trent: jumping in. what's the main worry here? maya: i noticed the badge color for 'quantized' is using --brand-200 which fails 3:1 on dark theme at small text sizes. also the focus outline doesn't show on the pill when tabbing through the row. andrew: repro'd. tab order goes: row -> overflow menu -> model name link. the pills are skipped since they're aria-hidden on the small variant. that's probably why screen readers don't hit them. sasha: yeah we hid them to reduce noise, but we still need them keyboard-focusable and discoverable via SR in verbose mode. aria-hidden feels wrong. trent: suggestion: keep visual noise down but expose to SR with aria-label + role="status" or role="note"? or put an offscreen text node like Quantized: yes. that way NVDA/VO will read it when navigating the row. maya: +1 for sr-only copy. for keyboard focus we can add tabindex=0 to the badge in compact rows, and style :focus with outline-offset and a 2px solid token that meets 3:1. aria-qa: NVDA-tip: role="status" will announce changes automatically which we don't want. better to use aria-label on a static element. Also check VoiceOver rotor behavior — ensure it doesn't create duplicate announcements. andrew: putting a small CSS snippet here I tried locally:```css .badge {background: var(--brand-200); color: var(--text-800);} /* fails contrast */ .badge--accessible {background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand-200) 70%, black 30%); color: #fff;} .badge:focus {outline: 2px solid var(--focus-500); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 12px;} ``` sasha: sweet — can we avoid changing brand tokens? prefer computed mix for theme-aware fix. add a storybook knob and a test case for keyboard nav. maya: will add story & a11y spec: "badge accessible contrast". also adding a screenshot diff so designers can sign off. trent: tiny copy nit: screen reader label should read "Quantized model — lower precision" rather than just "quantized" so context is clear in free-form nav. aria-qa: will run a quick VoiceOver/NVDA pass on mac/windows once PR is up. ETA: today EOD. sasha: awesome. assign to maya, tag @aria-qa for testing, @trent for code review. thanks y'all :white_check_mark: trent: one more: add keyboard hint in the row tooltip (e.g., "press Tab to focus badges") — we have space for a short microcopy in the condensed row hover. andrew: i'll add the tooltip and unit test for tabindex. sasha: perfect — moving to in-review. if QA catches anything blocking i'll follow up in thread. :shipit:
